role: One post-open Case 19 frame-zero gate for a deterministic solver-native half-ray correction appended to the sealed v258 endpoint. It is not candidate selection, endpoint blending, camera/component weighting, a larger Galerkin block, a learned model, a full-sequence result, or a resource result.
scientific_question: Can one balanced, exact, half-ray normal correction computed from the deployment-visible v258 residual recover K16-matched field, gradient, interior-gradient and observation accuracy on all thirteen opened Case 19 rigs while using fewer full-operator-equivalent ray traversals than K16?
physical_hypothesis: The sealed v258 field already has substantially lower field and gradient error than K16 but leaves a localized observation tail. A spatially interlaced half-ray sketch can form a new preconditioned normal direction that is absent from the closed nine-arm selector pool, while preserving every camera and both signed detector components. If this one sketched exact correction closes the small observation gap without destroying the field advantage, the missing mechanism is solver-native local ray refresh rather than arm selection.
design_evidence_boundary: Case 19, v258, v261, v262 and v263.1 are already open and may motivate this post-open diagnostic. No v264 Case 19 selected-ray normal, direction, coefficient, candidate field, residual, metric, pass count or gate value may be computed before this protocol, core, runner, validator and synthetic tests are committed. Synthetic tests must not read Case 19.

additional_parent.name: v261 sealed K15 and K16 controls

frozen_data_and_geometry.camera_roster: Reuse the exact v258 canonical nine-camera roster for every rig.
frozen_data_and_geometry.preprocessing: Reuse the exact v258 frame-zero parser, float64 rectilinear interpolation, one-voxel truth support and active-cell truth gauge.
frozen_data_and_geometry.truth_use: CFD truth generates the synthetic observation and scores four veto metrics only. It never enters the ray mask, partial operators, direction, coefficient, controls, fallback or stopping.

unique_primary.name: v258_endpoint_plus_even_quincunx_half_ray_preconditioned_normal_line_search
unique_primary.parent: Use the independently sealed v258 primary field and its exact deployment-visible residual. The inherited logical full-call ledger is 15A+14A^T.
unique_primary.ray_mask: For every camera retain exactly those detector rays with (u+v) mod 2 = 0, using zero-based reported detector coordinates. Retain both signed components for every selected ray. This selects 128/256 rays per camera and 1152/2304 rays overall. Camera identity, residual value, truth, rig and metric do not affect the mask.
unique_primary.partial_adjoint: Apply the exact reported-geometry adjoint restricted to the selected rays, with all unselected ray entries mathematically absent, to the selected v258 residual. This is one exact half-ray adjoint traversal, not one full A^T call.
unique_primary.direction: Multiply the selected-ray normal by the already sealed positive geometry-Jacobi inverse diagonal from v258. No support mask, component weight, camera weight, smoothing, clipping or learned map is added.
unique_primary.partial_forward: Apply the exact reported-geometry forward restricted to the same selected rays to the direction. This is one exact half-ray forward traversal, not one full A call.
unique_primary.coefficient: Use the unique unbounded selected-residual least-squares coefficient alpha=<q_S,r_S>/<q_S,q_S>. A non-positive or non-finite denominator, coefficient or direction makes execution invalid; there is no clipping, damping, threshold or fallback.
unique_primary.candidate: x_candidate=x_v258+alpha*d. The cached selected residual is r_S-alpha*q_S. One full forward replay is performed only by the offline scorer and is excluded from the deployment ledger exactly as for earlier metric replay.

forbidden_search: No ray fraction, parity, phase, coordinate origin, camera subset, component subset, residual-based mask, mask union, random seed, direction normalization, scale, alpha multiplier, alpha clipping, damping, ridge, regularization, second partial step, full-call depth, endpoint blend, metric threshold, rig rule or fallback may change after freeze. Do not try the odd parity after seeing the even-parity result. Do not rescue with a selector, CNN, FNO, UNO, DeepONet or GPU.

accuracy_gate.two_replica_envelope: For candidate and controls take the componentwise maximum of formal and independent metrics. For the K16 denominator take the componentwise minimum of every admitted independently sealed K16 replica. Passing therefore requires both implementations to pass every absolute and matched gate.
accuracy_gate.control_dominance: If sealed v258 or equal-total-ray-work K15 passes all thirteen absolute and matched envelope cells, the half-ray correction advantage is not isolated.

independent_validation.formal_implementation: Torch vectorized selected-ray trilinear interpolation and scatter-add using the frozen exact operator tensors.
independent_validation.independent_implementation: A separate program must use NumPy finite differences, explicit selected-ray trilinear gathers, numpy.add.at scatter accumulation, and scalar dot products. It must not import the v264 formal core or runner.
independent_validation.parent_replica: Formal uses the v258/v261 formal parents. Independent uses the separately sealed independent parent arrays. Each side rebuilds raw frame-zero observation and reported geometry before creating its candidate.
independent_validation.prediction_barrier: Both programs seal candidate field, selected-ray state, physical residual and call ledger before any truth metric is computed. The independent program seals its prediction tree before reading formal v264 scientific arrays.

decision_order: Any parent identity, parent tree, source, payload, shape, finite, mask, selected-ray operator, adjoint, normal identity, selected least-squares orthogonality, parent replay, full physical replay, permutation, call-ledger, prediction seal or prospective cross-implementation closure failure gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_CASE19_STRATIFIED_RAY_CORRECTION_FRAME_ZERO_V264.

If the unique primary fails any of the thirteen absolute or K16-matched two-replica-envelope cells, conclude FAIL_CASE19_STRATIFIED_RAY_CORRECTION_FRAME_ZERO_V264 and close this exact even-quincunx half-ray correction without trying another phase or fraction.
If the primary passes all thirteen but sealed v258 or equal-total-ray-work K15 also passes all thirteen, conclude PASS_CASE19_FRAME_ZERO_BUT_STRATIFIED_RAY_ADVANTAGE_NOT_ISOLATED_V264.

Only if the primary passes 13/13 absolute and matched cells, both controls remain incomplete, and every independent check passes may conclude POST_OPEN_CASE19_STRATIFIED_RAY_CORRECTION_HEADROOM_V264. This authorizes only one separately frozen full-sequence gate; it is not yet an algorithm, speed, external or real-BOST result.
failure_action: Close the fixed even-quincunx half-ray normal correction without changing parity, phase, fraction, coefficient, preconditioner, parent, depth, controls or thresholds. Do not train a selector or larger model and do not rent a GPU to rescue it.
